key: This screen lets you set up tweaks for the game ini file that will be applied to a user's setup when they use your collection.
zh: 此页面允许你设置游戏 ini 文件的调整，当用户使用你的整合包时，这些调整将被应用到他们的设置中。

key: Users can toggle these ini tweaks individually so you may want to set up multiple tweaks to give users granular control.
zh: 用户可以单独切换这些 ini 调整，所以你可能会想要设置多个调整以给用户提供更细致的控制。

key:
"Edit" allows you to input the ini tweak you want to apply to the target ini file. Please provide the section as well as your tweak(s). e.g.:

[General]
sIntroSequence=0
zh:
“编辑”允许你输入你想要应用到目标 ini 文件的 ini 调整。请提供相应的部分以及你的调整。例如：

[General]
sIntroSequence=0

key: To assist in the testing of INI configuration application - any enabled INI modification on this page will be applied to your own environment in the next deployment event; IF the collection mod is enabled.
zh: 协助测试 INI 配置应用 - 如果启用了整合包模组，此页面上任何启用的 INI 修改将在下一次部署事件中应用到你自己的环境中。

key: To disable/enable an INI tweak, simply click on the button itself (in the status column). If needed, INI tweak can be removed by clicking the arrow next to the button and selecting "Remove"
zh: 要禁用 / 启用一个 INI 调整，只需点击按钮本身（在状态列中）。如果需要，可以通过点击按钮旁边的箭头并选择“移除”来移除 INI 调整。

key: Download the latest meta information about your installed and owned collections. This will reset local changes to names of collections in your workshop.
zh: 下载关于你已安装和拥有的整合包的最新元信息。这将重置你在工坊中对整合包名称的本地更改。
在 Nexus Mods 上分享

key: This collection has been uploaded with a different account ({{uploadAuthor}}) than you're using now ({{currentUser}}). If you edit and upload this collection now it will be uploaded as a new collection by your current user.
zh: 此整合包是用不同的账户（{{uploadAuthor}}）上传的，而不是你现在使用的账户（{{currentUser}}）。如果你现在编辑并上传此整合包，它将作为你当前用户的新整合包上传。

key:
Deleting a collection will not remove the mods that have been added to it.

Any changes made to this collection since the last upload to Nexus Mods will be lost.

Are you sure you want to remove "{{collectionName}}" from your Workshop?
zh:
删除整合包不会移除已添加到其中的模组。

自上次上传到 Nexus Mods 以来对整合包所做的任何更改都将丢失。

你确定要将“{{collectionName}}”从你的工坊中移除吗？

key:
You can only upload collections that are fully installed on this system.
If you have removed mods that were part of this collection you may want to remove them from the collection as well. If this collection is connected to a profile you can simply update from that.
zh:
你只能上传在此系统上完全安装的整合包。
如果你已经移除了此整合包的一部分模组，你可能也想从整合包中移除它们。如果此整合包与一个配置文件相关联，你可以简单地从那里更新。

key: You have to be logged in with Nexus Mods to install collections.
zh: 你必须使用 Nexus Mods 登录才能安装整合包。

key: Already queued mod installations will still finish
zh: 已排定的模组安装仍将完成

key: Enter instructions here (Markdown supported - Links, Bold, Italics)
zh: 在这里输入说明（支持 Markdown——链接，粗体，斜体）

key: This collection has {{count}} optional mods which are not required to complete the installation but may provide additional features or options. You can view these mods before installing as they may change the default behavior of the collection or have additional requirements.
zh: 此整合包有 {{count}} 个可选模组，它们不是完成安装所必需的，但可能提供额外的功能或选项。你可以在安装前查看这些模组，因为它们可能会改变整合包的默认行为或有额外的要求。

key: Sorry to hear that the collection "undefined" isn't working for you. Here are some steps that could help:
zh: 很抱歉听到“未定义”整合包对您不起作用。以下是一些可能有帮助的步骤：

key: You can also add mods to a collection from the mods screen: Right-click > Add to Collection
zh: 您还可以从模组页面将模组添加到整合包：右键单击 > 添加到整合包

key: Mods need to be in an installed state in order to add them to a collection. If the mod you want to add is not in this list, make sure it's installed.
zh: 模组需要处于已安装状态才能将其添加到整合包中。如果您想添加的模组不在此列表中，请确保它已安装。
创建自己的整合包并与Nexus Mods社区分享。您可以在<1>这里</1>查看所有上传的整合包。

key: This collection has {{count}} optional mods which are not required to complete the installation but have been recommended by the curator. To view these mods, click the button below.
zh: 此整合包有 {{count}} 个可选模组，它们不是完成安装所必需的，但已被作者推荐。要查看这些模组，请点击下面的按钮。

key: This collection has {{count}} optional mods which are not required to complete the installation but have been recommended by the curator. To view these mods, click the button below._plural
zh: 此整合包有 {{count}} 个可选模组，它们不是完成安装所必需的，但已被作者推荐。要查看这些模组，请点击下面的按钮。

key: You now have the whole collection installed, you can start editing your collection by cloning it.
zh: 您现在已经安装了整个整合包，您可以通过克隆来开始编辑您自己的整合包。

key: Do you really want to delete this mod?_plural
zh: 您确定要删除这 {{count}} 个模组吗？

key: Please select the type of feedback you'd like to send in.
zh: 请选择您要发送的反馈类型。

key: Sorry, due to large amount of feedback we receive we can't accept feedback from older versions since the issue may already have been addressed.
zh: 对不起，由于我们收到的反馈实在太多，以至于我们不能接受旧版本的反馈，因为这个问题可能已经被解决了。

key: Describe in detail what you want to suggest.
zh: 请详细描述您想要建议的内容。

key: Describe in detail what you were doing and the feedback you would like to submit.
zh: 请详细描述您所做的事情和您想要提交的反馈。

key: Vortex does not impose any speed limitations on downloads, that's handled by the server.
zh: Vortex 不会对下载施加任何速度限制，这是由服务器处理的。

key: We can not forward your problems to the web department so please don't report temporary speed issues or problems regarding the non-premium speed cap through this form!
zh: 我们无法将您的问题转发给网络部门，因此请不要通过此表单报告临时速度问题或有关非 premium 账户的速度上限问题！

key: Please make sure you've read the login instructions in Vortex, on the authorisation page and consulted the knowledge base before reporting login issues.
zh: 请确保您已在授权页面上阅读了 Vortex 的登录说明，并在报告登录问题之前查询了知识库。

key: An error occurred removing a file
Sorry, the combined file size must not exceed 20MB
zh: 对不起，总计文件大小不得超过 20MB。

key:
Thank you for your feedback!

Your feedback will be reviewed before it gets published.
zh:
谢谢您的反馈！

您的反馈将在发表之前进行评审。

key: Click to browse for files to attach

E.g.:
Summary: The mod downloads properly but when I try to install it nothing happens.
Expected Results: The mod is installed.
Actual Results: Nothing happens.
Steps to reproduce: Download a mod, then click Install inside the Actions menu.
zh:
范例:
Summary: The mod downloads properly but when I try to install it nothing happens.
Expected Results: The mod is installed.
Actual Results: Nothing happens.
Steps to reproduce: Download a mod, then click Install inside the Actions menu.

key:
E.g.:
Summary: Please add a way to see the size of a mod on disk
Rationale: Space on my games partition is too limited so I want to delete the biggest, uninstalled mods.
Proposed Implementation: Add a column to the mods page that shows the size of the mod size.
zh:
范例：
Summary: Please add a way to see the size of a mod on disk
Rationale: Space on my games partition is too limited so I want to delete the biggest, uninstalled mods.
Proposed Implementation: Add a column to the mods page that shows the size of the mod size.

key: You have configured Vortex to run FNIS automatically but it's not installed for this game. For the automation to work, FNIS has to be installed and configured for the current game. You can download it from [url]{{url}}[/url].
zh: 您已将 Vortex 配置为自动运行 FNIS，但您并没有安装它。若想让它自动运行，您必须为当前游戏安装和配置 FNIS。您可以从 [url]{{url}}[/url] 下载它。

key: You have configured Vortex to run FNIS automatically but the installed version of FNIS is too old and doesn't support being embedded. Please download and install at least version 7.4 from [url]{{url}}[/url].
zh: 您已经将 Vortex 配置为自动运行 FNIS，但已安装的 FNIS 版本太旧，不支持嵌入。请从 [url]{{url}}[/url] 下载并安装，版本最低要求为 7.4。
选择此配置文件的补丁

zh: 无法读取可用补丁列表
无法计算 FNIS 校验和

key: An unknown error occurred starting FNIS. This is usually caused by a broken installation or the tool being set up incorrectly.
zh: 启动 FNIS 时发生未知错误。这通常是由于安装失败或工具设置不正确。

key:
Please select the patches to activate in FNIS (when run automatically!).
Only select patches you have the corresponding mod for!
This list is stored separately for each profile.
zh:
请选择 FNIS 中激活的补丁（自动运行时）！
只选择有对应模组的补丁！
这个列表分别存储在各自的配置文件中。

key: The extension providing BSA support has been disabled or removed. Without it, Vortex can't provide BSA redirection.
zh: 提供 BSA 支持的扩展已被禁用或删除。没有它，Vortex 就无法提供 BSA 重定向。
读取 bsa/ba2 文件失败。

key: Loose files may not get loaded
zh: 丢失文件可能无法加载

key: Due to oddities in the game engine, some loose files will not get loaded unless we change the filetime on the vanilla BSA/BA2 files. There is no drawback to doing this.
zh: 由于游戏引擎中的特性，我们必须更改 vanilla BSA/BA2 文件上的文件时间，否则一些松散文件将无法加载。这样做没有任何缺点。

key: This adds a mod to vortex that provides Archive Invalidation similar to mods like "Archive Invalidation Invalidated".
zh: 这为 Vortex 添加了一个模组，它提供类似于“Archive Invalidation Invalidated”之类的模组的压缩文件无效化。

key: Actual index differs. If this is the case after sorting it may be this index isn't possible.
zh: 实际索引不同。如果在排序后出现了这种情况，则这个索引也许是不合理的。

key: This might be a temporary network error. If it persists, please delete "{{masterlistPath}}" to force Vortex to download a new copy.
zh: 这可能是临时网络错误。如果问题仍然存在，请删除“{{masterlistPath}}”以强制 Vortex 下载新副本。

key: There were errors getting plugin information from LOOT
zh: 从 LOOT 获取插件信息时出错

key: Invalid fix instruction for cycle, please report this
zh: 修复循环指令无效，请反馈
未能成功报告插件循环问题

key: Plugins not sorted because of cyclic rules
zh: 插件因循环规则而未能排序

key: Your userlist refers to groups that don't exist: {{missing}}[br][/br]The most likely reason is that the masterlist has changed and dropped the group.[br][/br]This can be fixed automatically by removing all references to these groups.
zh: 您的用户列表指向不存在的组：{{missing}}[br][/br] 最可能的原因是主列表已更改并删除了组。[br][/br] 删除对这些组的所有引用可以自动修复这个问题。

key:
Your userlist contains multiple entries for "{{name}}". This is not allowed and Vortex shouldn't create entries like that, although earlier versions may have.
Please close vortex and remove duplicate entries from "{{userlistPath}}".
zh:
您的用户列表包含“{{name}}”的多个条目。这是不允许的，Vortex 不应该创建这样的条目，尽管早期版本可能有。
请关闭 vortex 并从“{{userlistPath}}”中删除重复的条目。

key:
Your userlist contains multiple identical "{{plugin}} after {{reference}}"rules. LOOT will not be able to sort plugins with this userlist.
To fix this, please close vortex and remove duplicate entries from "{{userlistPath}}".
zh:
您的用户列表包含多个相同的“{{plugin}} 在 {{reference}} 之后”规则。 LOOT 将无法使用此用户列表对插件进行排序。
要解决此问题，请关闭 vortex 并从“{{userlistPath}}”中删除重复的条目。"

key: A mod could no longer be found on disk. Please don't delete mods manually but uninstall them through Vortex.
zh: 无法在硬盘上找到模组。请不要手动删除模组，而是通过 Vortex 卸载它们。

key:
This file is used to control which plugins the game uses and while it's write protected Vortex will not be able to enable or disable plugins.
If you click "fix" the file will be marked writable.
zh:
此文件用于控制游戏使用的插件，当它受到写入保护时，Vortex 将无法启用或禁用插件。
如果单击“修复”，文件将被标记为可写。

key: failed to reset load order info
zh: 无法重置读取顺序信息

key: The masterlist couldn't be read. This might have been caused by network problems. You should go to the plugins tab and click the "Reset Masterlist" button, until then plugin sorting will not produce correct results.
zh: 无法读取主列表。这可能是由网络问题引起的。您应该转到插件选项卡并单击“重置主列表”按钮，在此之前，插件排序无法产生正确的结果。

key: Failed to read userlist file for this game. Repair or delete this file and then try to start Vortex again
zh: 无法读取此游戏的用户列表文件。修复或删除此文件，然后尝试再次启动 Vortex

key: This will remove customizations you have made to groups. This can't be undone!
zh: 这将删除您对组所做的自定义修改。这无法撤消！
将预配置的组还原为默认值

key: This screen shows only deployed plugins, if you're missing files, try deploying manually.
zh: 此页面仅显示已部署的插件，如果您丢失了文件，请尝试手动部署。

key: This plugin can't be an esl since it contains form-ids outside the valid range
zh: 此插件不能为 esl，因为它包含的表单 ID 超出了有效范围

key: This is a regular plugin that could be turned into a light one (also known as an ESPfe). When you do this, it will no longer take up a spot in the load order while still working as usual.
zh: 这是一个常规的插件，它可以转换为轻插件（也称为 ESPfe）。当您这样做时，它将不再占用加载顺序中的位置，但仍可正常工作。

key: Failed to mark plugins as light
zh: 未能将插件标记为轻插件

key: Failed to mark plugins as regular
zh: 未能将插件标记为常规插件

zh: 是否在当前配置文件中启用了插件

zh: 插件加载的顺序。高数值的插件会覆盖那些低数值的插件。

key: The Mod index is the first two hexadecimal digits of all ids this plugin adds to the game
zh: 模组索引是这个插件添加到游戏中的所有 id 的前两位十六进制数字

key: A light plugin doesn't occupy a regular load order slot. Only some plugins can be made light direcly.
zh: 轻插件不会占用常规加载位，仅有一些插件可以直接作为轻插件

In version 17 of the game 7 Days to Die the way mods are installed has changed considerably. Unfortunately we are now not able to support this change with the way mods were previously installed.
This means that for the mods to work correctly you have to reinstall them.
We are sorry for the inconvenience.
zh:
在 7 Days to Die 的第 17 版本中，模组的安装方式发生了很大的变化。不幸的是，我们现在无法通过以前安装模组的方式来支持这种更改.
这意味着要使模组正确工作，您必须重新安装它们。很抱歉给您带来不便。

key: The mod you're attempting to install has been created for game version: "{{modVer}}"; the currently installed game version is: "{{gameVer}}", version mismatches may cause unexpected results inside the game, please keep this in mind if you choose to continue.
zh: 您试图安装的模组是为“{{modVer}}”版本的游戏创建的；您现在的游戏版本为:“{{gameVer}}”, 版本不匹配可能会在游戏中导致未知错误，请谨慎操作。

key: The mod you're attempting to install is not compatible with Blade and Sorcery 6.0+ and cannot be installed by Vortex. Please check the mod page for an updated version.
zh: 您试图安装的模组与 Blade and Sorcery 6.0+ 不兼容，不能被 Vortex 安装。请查看模组页面以获得更新的版本。

key: Modding Dark Souls requires a tool called DSfix
zh: 给 Dark Souls 安装模组需要一个叫做 DSfix 的工具

key:
Most Dawn of Man mods require Unity Mod Manager to be installed to run correctly.
Once installed, UMM must be used to inject your mods into the game itself.
For ease of use, UMM comes pre-added as a tool for Dawn of Man but you may have
to configure it manually.
For usage information and download link please see UMM's page.

Please note: simpler "Scenario" mods can be used without UMM.
zh:
大多数 Dawn of Man 的模组需要安装 Unity Mod Manager（UMM）才能正确运行.
UMM 必须安装以用于将您的模组注入游戏本身.
为了便于使用，UMM 是作为 Dawn of Man 的工具预先添加的，但是您可能已经
手动配置它了.
有关使用信息和下载链接，请参见 UMM 的页面.

请注意：简单的“场景”模组可以在没有 UMM 的情况下使用。

zh: 请注意在游戏中启用模组

Vortex 对于 Resident Evil 2 的模组管理功能已得到加强，以更好地支持游戏的修改要求；特别是在安装非 dlc 的模组。

很抱歉给您带来不便。
转到 Mod Engine 页面

key:
Sekiro requires "Sekiro Mod Engine" for mods to install and function correctly.
Vortex is able to install Mod Engine automatically (as a mod) but please ensure it is enabled
and deployed at all times.

Sekiro 需要“Sekiro Mod Engine”才能正确安装和运行模组。
Vortex 可以自动安装模组引擎（作为模组），但请确保它已启用
并始终处于部署状态。

key: You must install SMAPI to use mods with Stardew Valley.
zh: 您必须安装 SMAPI 才能在 Stardew Valley 中使用模组。

key: You must install QModManager to use mods with Subnautica.
zh: 您必须安装 QModManager 以使用 Subnautica 的模组。

zh: 存在未解决的文件冲突。这意味着两个或多个模组包含相同的文件，您需要决定最后加载哪个模组，从而决定由哪个模组提供这些文件。

zh: 从模组依赖项派生的（derived）安装顺序

zh: 模组之间的依赖关系规则包含循环，如“A 在之后加载于 B”和“B 在之后加载于 A”。您需要删除导致循环的规则之一，否则您的模组无法以正确的顺序应用。

You have unresolved file conflicts {{more}}. In some cases this can lead to incompatible files being used which can cause all kind of problems inside the game.
Please address all file conflicts before running the game.
zh:
您有未解决的文件冲突 {{more}} 。在某些情况下这些不兼容的文件会在游戏中造成各种问题。

zh: 对不起，我无法识别这个模组压缩文件是从哪里安装的。请从下载选项卡通过安装文件重新安装。

key: Sorry, the meta data for this download is incomplete. Vortex has tried to refresh it, please try again.
zh: 抱歉，此下载的元数据不完整。 Vortex 试图刷新它，请再试一次。

key: Failed to determine installation directory. This shouldn't have happened
zh: 无法确定安装目录。这不应该发生

key: Can't delete mod during download or install
zh: 下载或安装时无法删除模组

key: This is a staging folder but it appears to belong to a different Vortex instance. If you're using Vortex in shared and "regular" mod, do not use the same staging folder for both!
zh: 这是一个模组存储文件夹，但它似乎属于另一个 Vortex。如果您在与其他人共享使用 Vortex 且有自己的规则和模组，请不要同时使用同一个模组存储文件夹！

key: This directory is not marked as a staging folder. Are you *sure* it's the right directory?
zh: 此目录未标记为模组存储文件夹。您 * 确定 * 这是正确的目录吗？

key:
The mod you're removing has already been deleted on disk.
This makes it impossible for Vortex to cleanly undeploy the mod so you may be left with files left over in your game directory.
You should allow Vortex to do a full deployment now to try and clean up as best as possible.
The mod will be removed after deployment is finished.
zh:
您要删除的模组已经在硬盘上被删除。
这使得 Vortex 无法干净地取消部署模组，因此您可能会在游戏目录中留下文件。
Y 您应该现在允许 Vortex 进行完全部署，以尽可能地清理。
部署完成后，模组将被删除。

key:
The deployment method used with this game is no longer available. This probably means you removed the corresponding extension or it can no longer be loaded due to a bug.
Vortex can't clean up files deployed with an unsupported method. You should try to restore it, purge deployment and then switch to a different method.
zh:
此游戏使用的部署方法不再可用。这可能意味着您删除了相应的扩展名，或者由于错误而无法再加载它。

Vortex 无法清除使用不受支持的方法部署的文件。您应该尝试恢复它，清除部署然后切换到另一种方法。

key:
The deployment method you had configured is no longer applicable.
Please resolve the problem described below or go to "Settings" and change the deployment method.
zh:
您配置的部署方法不再适用。
请解决下面描述的问题，或转到“设置”并更改部署方法。

key: The staging folder could not be created. You [b][color=red]have[/color][/b] to go to settings->mods and change it to a valid directory [b][color=red]before doing anything else[/color][/b] or you will get further error messages.
zh: 无法创建模组存储文件夹。您 [b][color=red] 必须 [/color][/b] 进入“设置 -> 模组”[b][color=red] 并在做任何其它事之前 [/color][/b] 将其更改为有效目录，否则您将会一直收到错误提示。

key: You need to select a deployment method in settings
zh: 您需要在设置中选择部署方法

key: Failed to deploy mods, please try again
zh: 无法部署模组，请再试一次
无效的模组存储目录 (模组存储目录不能在游戏目录里！)

key: An attempt to move the staging folder was interrupted. You should let Vortex clean up now, otherwise you may be left with unnecessary copies of files.
zh: 移动存储文件夹的操作被中断。您现在应该让 Vortex 进行清理，否则可能会留下不必要的文件副本。

key: Your mod staging folder is inside the Vortex application directory. This is a very bad idea beckaue that folder gets removed during updates so you would lose all your files on the next update.
zh: 您的模组存储文件夹位于 Vortex 应用程序目录中。这是一个非常糟糕的主意，因为在更新期间文件夹被删除，因此您将在下次更新时丢失所有文件。

key:
Your mod staging folder is inside the game folder.
This is a very bad idea because that folder is under the control of the game (and potentially Steam or similar) and may be moved or deleted - e.g. when the game is updated/repaired.
Please choose a separate folder for the staging folder, one that no other application uses.
zh:
您的模组存储目录位于游戏文件夹中。
这是一个非常糟糕的主意，因为该文件夹在游戏的控制之下（并且可能是 Steam 或类似的），可以被移动或删除 - 例如，当游戏更新 / 修复时。
请为模组存储目录选择一个单独的文件夹，一个没有其他应用程序使用的文件夹。

key: Source the mod was downloaded from
zh: 模组的源代码被下载于

zh: 保存清单失败（请参阅下面的错误）。这可能会导致以后的错误，

key: The deployment directory for some mod type(s) ({{ types }}) is unknown. Mods of these types will not be deployed. Maybe this/these type(s) require further configuration or external tools.
zh: 某些模组类型（{{types}}）的部署目录未知。这些类型的模组将不会部署。也许这个（些）类型需要进一步的配置或外部工具。

key: Some of the enabled mods either contain no files or all files they do contain are entirely overwritten by another mod. These redundant mods don't do any harm except slow down deployment a bit.
zh: 一些已启用的模组不包含文件，或者它们包含的所有文件都被另一个模组完全覆盖。除了减慢部署之外，这些冗余模组不会造成任何影响。

key: Can't deploy while the game or a tool is running
zh: 在游戏或工具运行时无法部署

Encountered errors extracting this archive. Please verify this file was downloaded correctly.
[list]{{ errors }}[/list]
zh:
解压此压缩文件时遇到错误。请确认此文件已正确下载。
[list]{{ errors }}[/list]

key:
The installer in "{{name}}" tried to install files that were not part of the archive.
This is a bug in the mod, please report it to the mod author.
Please note: NMM silently ignores this kind of errors so you might get this message for mods that appear to install fine with NMM. The mod will likely work, at least partially.
zh:
“{{name}}”中的安装程序试图安装不属于压缩文件的文件。
这是模组中的错误，请向模组作者报告。
请注意：NMM 默默忽略这种错误，因此，您可能会收到有关使用 NMM 安装正常的消息。模组可能会起作用，至少部分是有效的。
无效的模组安装程序说明

key: Failed to clean up installation directory "{{destinationPath}}", please close Vortex and remove it manually.
zh: 清理安装目录失败“{{destinationPath}}”，请关闭 Vortex 并手动将其清除。

key: The archive {{ installerPath }} is damaged and couldn't be installed. This is most likely fixed by re-downloading the file.
zh: 压缩文件 {{installerPath}} 已损坏，无法安装。这很可能可以通过重新下载文件来解决。

key: You need to select a game before installing this mod
zh: 您需要在安装此模组之前选择游戏

key: Empty archive or no options selected
zh: 空压缩文件或没有选择选项
没有安装程序支持此文件

key: Vortex is designed to install mods from archives but this doesn't look like one. Do you want to create a mod containing just this file?
zh: Vortex 的设计是从压缩文件来安装模组的，但是这个文件似乎不是压缩文件。是否要创建一个直接包含此文件的模组？

key: An older version of this mod is already installed. You can replace the existing one - which will update all profiles - or install this one alongside it. In the latter case both versions will be available and only the active profile will be updated.
zh: 此模组的旧版本已安装。您可以替换现有版本（这将更新所有配置文件），或将此版本与其一同安装。在后一种情况下，两个版本都可用，仅启用的配置文件会被更新。

key: This mod seems to be installed already. You can replace the existing one - which will update all profiles - or install the new one under a different name. If you do the latter, the new installation will appear as a variant of the other mod that can be toggled through the version dropdown. Use the input below to make the variant distinguishable.
zh: 此模组似乎已被安装，你可以替换现有那个（更新全部配置），或以不同的名字安装一个新的。如果你选择后者，新的安装将会显示为变体以通过下拉版本选项进行切换。填写下面的变体来区分。

key: A password is required to extract this archive
zh: 解压这个压缩文件需要密码
安装程序使用了未实现的功能

key: This installer is (partially) unsupported as it's using functionality that hasn't been implemented yet. Please help us fix this by submitting an error report with a link to this mod.
zh: 此安装程序（部分）不受支持，因为它使用的功能尚未实现。请通过提交带有此模组的链接的错误报告来帮助我们解决此问题。

key:
{{count}} files were not correctly deployed (see log for details).
The most likely reason is that files were locked by external applications so please ensure no other application has a mod file open, then repeat deployment.
zh:
{{count}} 个文件未正确部署（详见日志）。
最可能的原因是文件被外部应用程序锁定（占用），因此请确保没有其他应用程序打开模组文件，然后重新部署。

key: Are you sure you want to cancel? This will leave backup files unrestored, you will have to clean those up manually.
zh: 您确定要取消？这将使备份文件无法恢复，您将不得不手动清理它们。

key:
The mod folder for this game is not writable to your user account.
If you have admin rights on this system, Vortex can change the permissions to allow it write access.
zh:
此游戏的模组文件夹无法写入您的用户帐户。
如果您对此系统具有管理员权限，则 Vortex 可以更改权限以允许对其进行写入和访问。

key: A picture provided by the author
Time when this mod was installed

Mod deployment {{more}} is pending.[br][/br]This means that changes made to mods such as updating, enabling/disabling, as well as newly set mod rules need to be deployed to take effect.[br][/br]You can skip this step, ignoring (but not reverting) newly made changes to mods and mod rules, or deploy now to commit the changes.
zh: 正在等待部署模组 {{more}} 。[br][/br] 这意味着需要部署对模组进行的更改，这样例如更新，启用 / 禁用以及新设置的模组规则才能生效。[br][/br] 您可以跳过此步骤，忽略（但不还原）对模组规则进行的新更改，或立即部署以提交更改。

key: If you have multiple copies of the same mod installed (e.g. with different settings made) they will be merged into one line on the mod list between which you can toggle. Use the variant field to distinguish between them. E.g. you could have a "1k" and a "2k" variant of a mod installed.
zh: 如果您安装了同一个模组的多个副本（例如，进行了不同的设置），那么它们将合并到模组列表中的一行中，您可以在它们之间切换。使用变体字段来区分它们。例如，您可以安装“1K”和“2K”的两个（不同清晰度的）变体（variant）模组。

key:
The "Source" specifies where you got the mod. That source will be consulted for certain features, i.e. to find updates.

Only sources that are supported by Vortex can be selected.
If the mod was removed from the source it may make sense to select no source here to quiet error messages.
zh:
“下载源”指定了您获得模组的网站。对于某些功能，比如查找更新，将查询该下载源。

您只能选择 Vortex 支持的下载源。
如果下载源中已经删除了此模组，您则可以在此处选择“其他”来避免错误消息。

key: Corrupted mod info will be reset
zh: 损坏的模组信息将被重置

key: Mod with invalid attribute will be reset.
zh: 具有无效属性的模组将被重置。

key: Corrupted mod changelog will be reset
zh: 损坏的模组更新日志将被重置

key: Severe! Invalid set of staging folders
zh: 严重！无效的模组存储文件夹

key: Severe! A mod staging folder was corrupted and has to be reset
zh: 严重！模组存储文件夹已损坏，必须重置。

key:
IMPORTANT: This game was modded by another instance of Vortex.

Vortex can only proceed by purging the mods from that other instance.

This will irreversably **destroy** the mod installations from that other instance!

You should instead cancel now, open that other vortex instance and purge from there. This can also be caused by switching between shared and single-user mode.
zh:
重要提示：此游戏由另一个 Vortex 实例修改。

Vortex 只能通过从其他实例中清除模组来继续。

这将不可逆转地 ** 破坏 ** 来自其他实例的模组安装！
您现在应该取消，打开那个其他的 vortex 实例并从那里清除。这也可以通过在共享和个人模式之间切换来实现。

key:
The deployment manifest has been corrupted.
Fortunately we have a backup that seems to be intact.
zh:
部署清单已损坏。
幸运的是，我们有一个似乎完好无损的备份。

key: Can't purge while the game or a tool is running
zh: 在游戏或工具运行时无法清除
没有兼容的游戏被管理

zh: 下载是针对不同的游戏

zh: 与此下载相关的游戏不受管理，安装当前管理的游戏？

zh: 正在下载的：“{{fileName}}”未标记其兼容的游戏。请问您想为哪个游戏安装它？

key: This mod was not installed completely, most likely the installation got interrupted before. You should delete it now and then install it again.
zh: 这个模组的安装未完成，很可能是因为之前的安装被中断了。您现在应该删除它，然后重新安装。

key:
Mods have been changed on disk. This means that mods that were managed by Vortex disappeared and/or mods that Vortex previously didn't know about appeared in the staging folder since the last time it checked.
It is highly discouraged to modify the staging folder outside Vortex in any way!
zh:
硬盘上的模组已更改。这意味着，由 Vortex 管理的模组消失了，或自上次检查以来，Vortex 以前不知道的模组出现在暂存文件夹中。
强烈建议您不要在 Vortex 之外以任何方式修改暂存文件夹！

key: You have to select a deployment method first
zh: 您必须首先选择一个部署方法

key: Failed to purge mods, please try again
zh: 无法清除模组，请再试一次

key:
Purging will remove all links deployed to the game directory.
This is not a destructive operation, on the next deployment all links will be restored.
Use this operation to force a complete re-deployment or to restore the game directory to an unmodded-state.
zh:
清除模组将会断开模组到游戏目录的所有链接。
这不是破坏性操作，在下一次部署模组时将恢复所有链接。
您可以使用此操作完成强制重新部署或将游戏目录还原为未修改状态。

key: Mod files were changed outside Vortex. You can undo these changes now or apply them permanently.
zh: 模组文件在 Vortex 之外被更改。您可以立即撤消这些变更，也可以永久应用这些更改。

key: File content modified ("Save" will apply the changed file from the game directory permanently, "Revert" will restore the original file from the mod directory)
zh: 修改后的文件内容（选择“保存 (Save)”将永久地从游戏目录应用修改后的文件，选择“还原 (Revert)”将从模组目录恢复原始文件）

key: Source files were deleted ("Save" will remove the files permanenly, "Revert" will restore them)
zh: 源文件被删除（选择“保存 (Save)”将永久删除文件，选择“还原 (Revert)”将恢复它们。

key: Links were deleted ("Save" will remove the files permanently, "Revert" will restore them)

key: Source files were deleted("Save" will remove the files permanenly, "Revert" will restore them)

key: Links were deleted("Save" will remove the files permanently, "Revert" will restore them)
zh: 链接已删除（选择“保存 (Save)”将永久删除文件，选择“还原 (Revert)”将恢复它们）

key: Number of files in this mod that were changed
zh: 此模组中已更改的文件数

key: the action to take on files in this mod
zh: 对此模组中的文件采取的操作

key: Last time the stage file (the one in the mod staging folder) was modified
zh: 上次修改了存储文件（模组存储文件夹中的文件）

key: Last time the deployed file (the one in the game folder) was modified
zh: 上次部署的文件（游戏文件夹中的文件）被修改了

zh: 保存更改（使用已部署的文件）
还原更改（使用暂存文件）

zh: 您即将 [color="red"] 删除 [/color] {{count}} 个文件。 请问您确定继续吗？

zh: 使用较新的文件进行所有更改

Settings on this page can be set for each game individually.
zh: 可以为每个游戏单独设置此页面上的设置。

The mods staging folder has been copied [b]successfully[/b] to your chosen destination!
Clean-up of the old staging folder has been cancelled.

zh:
模组暂存文件夹已 [b] 成功地 [/b] 复制到您选择的目标！
旧暂存文件夹的清理已被取消。

旧暂存文件夹: [url]{{thePath}}[/url]

key: This will suggest a path that should allow you to deploy mods for the current game
zh: 这将建议一条路径，以允许您为当前游戏部署模组

zh: 无法移动目录，请再试一次

key: You need to select directories that the current user account can write to!
zh: 您需要选择当前用户帐户可以写入的目录！

key: Failed to purge previous deployment, please try again
zh: 无法清除以前的部署，请再试一次

key: The active game is not discovered correctly. If you have an idea what led to this, please report.
zh: 活动中的游戏没有被正确地发现。如果您知道是什么原因，请反馈。

key:
You can not put mods into the game directory. This directory is under the control of the game (and potentially Steam or similar) so your mods might be deleted or moved or otherwise damaged by foreign software.
Please choose a separate folder for staging folder, one that no other application uses.
zh:
您不能模组存储目录设定到游戏目录中。此目录受游戏控制（还可能是 Steam 或类似的软件），因此您的模组可能会被外部软件删除、移动或以其他方式损坏。
请为存储文件夹选择一个单独的、空的文件夹，而不是被其他应用程序所使用的文件夹。

key:
You do not have enough disk space to move the staging folder to your proposed destination folder.

Please select a different destination or free up some space and try again!
zh:
您没有足够的硬盘空间来将存储文件夹移动到建议的目标文件夹。

请选择其他目的地或释放一些空间，然后重试！

key: Previous deployment couldn't be cleaned up because the deployment method is no longer available (maybe you removed the corresponding extension?). If you continue now you may get orphaned files that Vortex can no longer clean up for you.
zh: 无法清理以前的部署，因为部署方法不再可用 (可能您删除了相应的扩展？) 如果您现在继续，您可能会得到独立的文件，Vortex 不能再为你清理。

key: Staging folder can't be a subdirectory of the Vortex application folder.
zh: 模组存储文件夹不能是 Vortex 应用程序文件夹的子目录。

key: Staging path shouldn't be too long, otherwise mod installers may fail.
zh: 模组存储文件夹不应太长，否则模组安装程序可能会失败。

key: Staging folder needs to be an absolute path.
zh: 模组存储文件夹需要是绝对路径。

key: Mod should be disabled or downgraded because this version has been marked as "bugged" by the author
zh: 模组应该被禁用或降级，因为该版本已被作者标记为“bugged”（有 Bug）

key: Deploys mods by actually moving files to the destination directory.
zh: 通过将文件移动到目标目录来部署模组

key:
You're about to enable "Move Deployment".
Please note that move deployment is slightly slower, uses more disk space and is less robust regarding changes from external applications than "Hardlink Deployment".
There are no advantages compared to hardlink deployment except that it also works on FAT32 formatted drives.
So please only use this if hardlink really is no option.
zh:
您将启用“移动部署（Move Deployment）”。
请注意，与“硬链接部署（Hardlink Deployment）”相比，移动部署稍微慢一些，它使用更多的硬盘空间，并且在应付来自外部应用程序更改时表现的没那么稳定。
与硬链接部署相比，它没有任何优势，除了它可以在 FAT32 格式的驱动器上工作。
所以，请尽量避免使用移动部署，除非硬链接部署对于您来说确实无法使用。

zh: 未为此帐户创建链接（{{userName}}）。您必须使用在 Vortex 中使用的相同帐户登录 nexusmods.com。

key: Clicking RETRIEVE you will lose all your changes
zh: 点击“恢复”按钮您将会丢失所有变更。

key:

key:
Categories are maintained as a tree, so for example the Category "Audio" could have child categories "Effects" and "Music". If you're using the Categories from Nexus, you will find that all categories have a rather useless "root" that corresponds to the game name, so the whole path would be "Skyrim -> Audio -> Effects".
This option will shorten the displayed category by hiding that root.
zh:
分类的结构类似于树，例如，分类“音频”可以具有子分类“效果”和“音乐”。如果您正在使用来自 Nexus 的分类，您会发现所有分类都有一个与游戏名称相对应的无用的“主分类”。因此整个路径将是：“Skyrim -> 音频 -> 效果”。

If this collection is your own, your uploads will be revisions of that existing collection, otherwise you will create a new collection associated with your own account.

如果这个整合包是您自己的，您的上传将成为该现有整合包的版本，否则您将创建一个与您自己的账户关联的新整合包。

zh: 您只能编辑在此设置中完全安装的整合包。请确保您安装了整合包的所有可选项目，然后将其克隆到工坊。

zh: 只能导出完全安装的整合包

zh: 创建一个包含当前配置文件中启用的模组的整合包。

key: Please enter a name for your new collection
zh: 请为您的新整合包输入名称

key: The collection will include your custom load order rules so that users of your collection will get the same load order.
zh: 整合包将包含您的自定义加载顺序规则，以便您的整合包用户获得相同的加载顺序。

You can also add mods to a collection from the mods screen: Right-click > Add to Collection
zh: 您也可以从模组屏幕添加模组到整合包：右键点击 > 添加到整合包

key: Mods need to be in an installed state in order to add them to a collection. If the mod you want to add is not in this list, make sure it's installed.
zh: 要将模组添加到整合包，它们必须处于已安装状态。如果您想要添加的模组不在此列表中，请确保它已安装。

key: Obviously users will need to have these tools installed. If they aren't included in the game and not installed as a mod through this collection, you should include instructions for the user on how to get the tool.
zh: 显然，用户需要安装这些工具。如果它们没有包含在游戏内，也没有通过这个整合包作为模组安装，您应该为用户提供获取该工具的说明。

key: Create an empty collection which you can manually add mods to.
zh: 创建一个空整合包，您可以手动添加模组。

key: File overrides can be considered as a type of ignore list. This page will allow you to export file overrides that are defined for your selected mod list. As of Vortex 1.10.x, the file overrides are generated automatically based on mod rules you export as part of your collection.
zh: 文件覆盖可以被视为一种忽略列表。这个页面将允许您导出为选定模组列表定义的文件覆盖。从 Vortex 1.10.x 开始，文件覆盖将根据您作为整合包一部分导出的模组规则自动生成。

key: Please note that these pre-generated file overrides are toggled off by default as Vortex will generate them on the users machine as part of the collection installation automatically. Therefore there's no explicit need to export these overrides unless you have manually set certain overrides which are not generated by the mod dependency system.
zh: 请注意，这些预生成的文件覆盖默认是关闭的，因为 Vortex 会在用户机器上作为整合包安装的一部分自动生成它们。因此，除非您手动设置了某些不被模组依赖系统生成的覆盖，否则没有明确需要导出这些覆盖。

key: Any mods enabled below will NOT be deployed on the user's machine. Please use this feature sparingly as most users are not aware that Vortex offers this functionality and may encounter trouble when trying to tweak/remove them.
zh: 下面启用的任何模组都不会在用户的机器上部署。请谨慎使用此功能，因为大多数用户不知道 Vortex 提供此功能，尝试调整 / 移除时可能会遇到麻烦。

key: By default the collection will replicate all your custom rules that dictate the deployment order of mods.
zh: 默认情况下，整合包将复制您所有的自定义规则，这些规则决定了模组的部署顺序。

key: If you disable rules here your collection may produce unresolved file conflicts that the user has to resolve.
zh: 如果您在这里禁用规则，您的整合包可能会产生用户需要解决的未解决文件冲突。

key: Version: Choose whether the collection will install exactly the version you have yourself or whatever is current on Nexus Mods.
zh: 版本：选择整合包是安装您自己拥有的确切版本，还是 Nexus Mods 上当前的版本。

key: Required: Select whether the user has to install the mod or whether it's an optional recommendation, recommended mods are presented last and the user is given the choice to install them or not.
zh: 必需：选择用户是否必须安装模组，或者它是一个可选推荐，推荐模组最后呈现，用户可以选择是否安装。

key: When using "Nexus Mods" as a source, both the mod id and file id have to be known. If you didn't download the mod through Vortex they may not be set. To solve this you have to change the source of the mod to "Nexus Mods" and use the options below "Nexus Mods IDs" to fill in the missing data (the automated options should be quite reliable).
zh: 当使用“Nexus Mods”作为来源时，必须知道模组 ID 和文件 ID。如果您没有通过 Vortex 下载模组，它们可能未设置。要解决这个问题，您必须将模组的来源更改为“Nexus Mods”，并使用下面的“Nexus Mods ID”选项填写缺失的数据（自动化选项应该相当可靠）。

key: "Replicate" install can only be used when installing a specific version of a mod. This will definitively break as soon as the mod gets updated.
zh: “复制”安装只能在安装特定版本的模组时使用。一旦模组更新，这将明确失效。

key: Installing with "Same choices options" may break if the mod gets updated, you may want to switch to "Prefer exact" to be safe.
zh: 如果模组更新，使用“相同的选择选项”可能会失效，您可能希望切换到“优先精确”以保持安全。

key: If you bundle a mod the user gets exactly the version of the mod you have, the Version selection is pointless in this case.
zh: 如果您内置了一个模组，用户将获得您拥有的模组的确切版本，在这种情况下，版本选择是没有意义的。

key: The option to "prefer exact version" only works with sources that support mod updates (Nexus Mods). For other sources your options are to use the exact same version you have locally or to accept whatever version the user downloads.
zh: “优先精确版本”选项仅适用于支持模组更新的来源（Nexus Mods）。对于其他来源，您的选项是使用您本地拥有的确切相同版本，或接受用户下载的任何版本。

key: The sources "Browse a website" and "Direct download" require that you provide a URL to download from.
zh: “浏览网站”和“直接下载”来源要求您提供一个下载的 URL。

key: Local edits can only be applied if the user gets the exact same files as you have installed locally, meaning they have to use the exact same version of the mod.
zh: 只有当用户获得与您本地安装的完全相同的文件时，本地编辑才能应用，这意味着他们必须使用模组的确切相同版本。

key: The option to "bundle" already bundles the edited files, storing the edits separately would not be useful as they can't and don't have to be applied.
zh: “内置”选项已经内置了编辑过的文件，单独存储编辑内容是没有用的，因为它们不需要也不能被应用。

key: "Replicate" depends on files being unchanged from the originals in the archive. If you modified mod files (as Binary Patching implies), "Replicate" will fail.
zh: “复制”依赖于文件与存档中的原始文件保持不变。如果您修改了模组压缩文件（正如二进制修补所暗示的），“复制”将失败。

key: Mods are copyright protected, only pack mods if you are sure you have the right to do so, e.g. if it's dynamically generated content or if it's your own mod.
zh: 模组受版权保护，只有在您确信有权这样做时才捆绑模组，例如，如果是动态生成的内容或您自己的模组。

key: Please verify you are allowed to do direct download on this site
zh: 请确认您被允许在该网站上进行直接下载

key: Most websites don't allow direct downloads, Plese make sure you are allowed to use direct links to the specified page.
zh: 大多数网站不允许直接下载，请确保您有权使用指定页面的直接链接。

key: The installer choices for this mod haven't been saved. This currently only works with xml-based fomods installed with Vortex 1.5.0 or later. You may have to reinstall the mod for this to work.
zh: 此模组的安装器选择尚未保存。目前，这仅适用于与 Vortex 1.5.0 或更高版本一起安装的基于 xml 的 fomods。您可能需要重新安装模组以使其生效。

key: The mod has no version number set. This isn't strictly necessary, we use the file id to identify the exact version but for the purpose of informing the user it would be nicer if a version was specified. (Please don't forget to update the collection)
zh: 模组没有设置版本号。这并非绝对必要，我们使用文件 ID 来确定确切版本，但为了通知用户，最好指定一个版本。（请不要忘记更新整合包）

key: To enable this feature, the corresponding archive has to exist to compare against.
zh: 要启用此功能，必须存在相应的压缩文件以供比较。

key: Whether the entire collection will fail if this mod is missing
zh: 如果缺少此模组，整个整合包是否会失败

key: How the user acquires the mod
How the mod should be installed on the user system
zh: 模组应如何在用户系统上安装

key:
If set to "Fresh Install" the mod will simply be installed fresh on the users system, installer (if applicable) and everything.
If set to "Replicate" Vortex will try to replicate your exact setup for this mod. This does not bundle the mod itself but the list of files to install and patches if necessary. This may increase the size of the collection and the time it takes to export it considerably.
zh:
如果设置为“全新安装”，模组将简单地在用户系统上全新安装，包括安装程序（如果适用）和所有内容。
如果设置为“复制”，Vortex 将尝试复制您对此模组的确切设置。这不包括模组本身，而是包括安装所需的文件列表和必要的补丁。这可能会大大增加整合包的大小和导出所需的时间。

key: With this option enabled, any changes you did to the files in this mods will also be included in the Collection.
zh: 启用此选项后，您对此模组文件所做的任何更改也将包含在整合包中。

key: Please select the install mode to apply to all selected mods
zh: 请选择要应用于所有选定模组的安装模式

key: Please choose how Vortex should choose the version of the mod to be installed. "Exact" means that the user should install the same version as you have installed right now. "Latest" means it should get the newest version at the time of installation.
zh: 请选择 Vortex 如何选择要安装的模组版本。“精确”意味着用户应安装与您当前安装的相同版本。“最新”意味着在安装时应获取最新版本。

key: Are you sure you want to remove these mods from this collection? Removing the mods from the collection will not remove them from Vortex.
zh: 您确定要从此整合包中移除这些模组吗？从整合包中移除模组不会从 Vortex 中移除它们。

key: You have to either fix the IDs for this mod or change how the collection acquires this mod.
zh: 您必须修复此模组的 ID，或更改整合包获取此模组的方式。

key: Congratulations! Please consider endorsing this collection if you are enjoying it. Endorsing helps others discover this collection and lets the curator know you enjoyed it.
zh: 恭喜！如果您喜欢这个整合包，请考虑为其点赞。点赞有助于他人发现这个整合包，并让作者知道您喜欢它。

key: Is the mod required for this collection
zh: 这个模组是整合包必需的吗？

key: The collection you're trying to clone is incomplete. Vortex can not include a mod in a collection that isn't installed so if you continue, the clone will not include these missing mods..
zh: 您尝试克隆的整合包不完整。Vortex 无法将未安装的模组包含在整合包中，所以如果您继续，克隆将不包含这些缺失的模组。

key: You now have the whole collection installed, you can start editing your collection by cloning it.
zh: 您现在已经安装了整个整合包，可以通过克隆它来开始编辑您的整合包。

key: For your safety the knowledge base browser is limited to the "Modding.wiki" domain. A link you've clicked lies outside this domain and can only be viewed in your regular browser - please ensure you trust the URL below before allowing Vortex to open that page in your default browser.
zh: 出于安全考虑，知识库浏览器仅限于“Modding.wiki”域。您点击的链接位于该域之外，只能在您的常规浏览器中查看 - 在允许 Vortex 在默认浏览器中打开该页面之前，请确保您信任下面的 URL。

Due to the high volume of feedback we get we can not follow up on reports missing such basic information. If you proceed, please understand that we may overlook your report if we can't tell what went wrong from the error message alone.
zh: 您即将提交一个没有日志文件的错误报告。这样的报告几乎永远不足以识别问题。由于我们收到的反馈量很大，我们无法跟进缺少这些基本信息的报告。如果您继续，请注意，如果我们无法仅从错误消息中得知出了什么问题，我们可能会忽略您的报告。

key: Some of the archives in your load order are incompatible with {{thisGame}}. Using incompatible archives may cause your game to crash on load.
zh: 您的加载顺序中的一些压缩文件与 {{thisGame}} 不兼容。使用不兼容的存档可能会导致游戏在加载时崩溃。

key: You can fix this problem yourself by removing any mods that are not intended to be used with {{thisGame}}. If you downloaded these mods from the correct game site at Nexus Mods, you should inform the mod author of this issue. Archives for this game must be {{ext}} files (v{{ver}}).
zh: 您可以自己解决这个问题，方法是移除任何不打算与 {{thisGame}} 一起使用的模组。如果您是从 Nexus Mods 的正确游戏站点下载这些模组的，您应该告知模组作者这个问题。此游戏的压缩文件必须是 {{ext}} 文件（v {{ver}}）。

不兼容的模组压缩文件

key: Plugins shouldn't exceed mod index {{maxIndex}} for a total of {{count}} plugins (including base game and DLCs) as the game will behave oddly otherwise. Please disable or attempt to mark plugins as light (if applicable) in the Plugins page
zh: 插件不应超过模组索引 {{maxIndex}}，总共 {{count}} 个插件（包括基础游戏和 DLC），否则游戏的行为会很奇怪。请在插件页面禁用或尝试将插件标记为轻插件（如果适用）

key: You've exceeded the plugin limit for your game
zh: 您已超过游戏的插件限制

key: The profile you just deleted had savegames associated with it. Do you want to remove those savegames now? If you don't, they will still be on disk in {{savesPath}} but they won't show up in the game until you move them.
zh: 您刚刚删除的配置文件与之关联的存档。您现在要移除这些存档吗？如果您不这样做，它们仍将位于 {{savesPath}} 磁盘上，但直到您移动它们，它们才会在游戏中显示。

key: The profile you're trying to import from doesn't exist, did you recently delete it?
zh: 您尝试导入的配置文件不存在，您最近是否删除了它？

key: Whether this save is a autosave/quicksave or manual one
zh: 这个存档是自动保存 / 快速保存还是手动保存

zh: 扩展需要重启以完成 UFD 设置。扩展现在将退出 - 请通过游戏页面或仪表板重新激活它。

zh: 7DTD 的模组模式正在改变。游戏目录内的模组路径正在被弃用，位于旧路径的模组将在未来不再工作。请选择您的用户定义文件夹（UDF）- Vortex 将部署到这个新位置。

Vortex 可以为您下载并尝试安装新更新。

Version 0.3 of the extension is almost a complete rewrite of load order and migration from previous versions may cause issues.

key: Change the load order with drag&drop.

You can adjust the load order for Blade and Sorcery by dragging and dropping mods up or down on this page. As the game loads its mods alphabetically - the AAA-ZZZ prefix will be added to the mod's folder name on every deployment event to guarantee that the game loads the mods in the order set inside Vortex. The higher prefix will win any conflicts (ZZZ > AAA)
zh: 你可以调整 Blade and Sorcery 的加载顺序，通过在这个页面上上下拖动模组。当游戏按字母顺序加载模组时，AAA-ZZZ 前缀将添加到每个部署事件的模组文件夹名中，以保证游戏按照 Vortex 中设置的顺序加载模组。较高的前缀将获得各种冲突（ZZZ>AAA）

key: For the load order to be reflected correctly within the game's mods directory, the mods must be re-deployed once you've finished changing the load order.
zh: 为了使加载顺序正确反映在游戏的模组目录中，一旦更改了加载顺序，就必须重新部署模组。

key: If you cannot see your manually added mod in this load order, you may need to manually set the wanted prefix by renaming the mod's folder in the mods folder directly. as an example, lets say you have installed "FakeMod" and want to add it below your AAA-UnlimitedPotions mod, simply rename "FakeMod" to "AAB-FakeMod" and click the refresh button.
zh: 如果看不到按此加载顺序手动添加的模组，则可能需要通过直接在模组文件夹中重命名模组的文件夹来手动设置所需的前缀。例如，假设您已经安装了“FakeMod”，并想将其添加到 AAA-UnlimitedPotions 模组下，只需将“FakeMod”重命名为“AAB-FakeMod”，然后单击刷新按钮即可。

key: Manually added mods are restricted to the prefix you set and Vortex has functionality to ensure this is respected, e.g. AAB-MyMod, Vortex will pick up on that prefix and sort it correctly in the load order (e.g. after AAA-SomeMod but before AAC-AnotherMod).
zh: 手动添加的模组仅限于您设置的前缀，并且 Vortex 具有确保遵守此规定的功能，例如 AAB-MyMod，Vortex 会选择该前缀并按加载顺序对其正确排序（例如，在 AAA-SomeMod 之后但在 AAC-AnotherMod 之前）。

key: Drag and drop the mods on the left to reorder them. Code Vein loads mods in alphabetic order so Vortex prefixes the directory names with "AAA, AAB, AAC, ..." to ensure they load in the order you set here.
zh: 将模组拖放到左边重新排序。Code Vein 按字母顺序加载模组，因此 Vortex 在目录名前面加上“AAA, AAB, AAC，…”以确保它们能按照您在这里设置的顺序进行加载。

key: Please note: if you are happy with your current mod setup, and have not noticed any issues, it is perfectly possible that you are not affected and shouldn't feel forced to re-install, but should keep an eye out for weird behaviour.
zh: 请注意：如果您对您目前的模组设置很满意，没有发现任何问题，有可能您没有受到任何影响，您无需重装，但要在日后注意观察是否存在异常。

zh: 选中要在游戏中激活的模组旁边的框。

zh: 单击工具栏中的自动排序。（有关详细信息，请参见下文）。

key: Make sure to run the game directly via the Play button in the top left corner (on the Bannerlord tile). Your Vortex load order may not be loaded if you run the Single Player game through the game launcher.

key: Optional: Manually drag and drop mods to different positions in the load order (for testing different overrides). Mods further down the list override mods further up.
zh: 可选：手动将模组拖放到加载顺序的不同位置（用于测试不同的替代）。列表下方的模组会覆盖列表上方的模组。

key: The load order reflected here will only be loaded if you run the game via the play button in the top left corner. Do not run the Single Player game through the launcher, as that will ignore the Vortex load order and go by what is shown in the launcher instead.
zh: 仅当您通过左上角的开始按钮运行游戏时，才会加载此处显示的加载顺序。不要通过启动器运行单人游戏，因为这将忽略 Vortex 加载顺序，而是按照启动器中显示的顺序进行。

key: For Bannerlord, mods sorted further towards the bottom of the list will override mods further up (if they conflict). Note: Harmony patches may be the exception to this rule.
zh: 对于 Bannerlord，在列表底部进一步排序的模组将覆盖更高的模组（如果它们冲突）。注意：和谐补丁可能是该规则的例外。

key: Auto Sort uses the SubModule.xml files (the entries under <DependedModules>) to detect dependencies to sort by.
zh: 自动排序使用 SubModule.xml 文件（<DependedModules> 下的条目）检测排序依据。

key: If you cannot see your mod in this load order, Vortex may have been unable to find or parse its SubModule.xml file. Most - but not all mods - come with or need a SubModule.xml file.
